explanation.heading: LESSON OBJECTIVE
explanation.text: Find and interpret the most frequent value or category in a data set, including ties, frequency tables, and combined groups.

explanation.heading: WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW
explanation.text: The mode describes what occurs most often, not what is numerically largest. It works for numerical and categorical data.

explanation.heading: KEY DEFINITIONS
explanation.text: Frequency is the number of appearances. A mode is any value tied for the greatest frequency. Bimodal means two modes.

explanation.heading: CORE RULE
explanation.text: Count occurrences for each distinct value. The value(s) with greatest frequency are the modes. If all distinct values occur equally often, report no mode under this course convention.

explanation.heading: HOW IT WORKS
explanation.text: Organize raw observations into a tally, compare counts, then state the data value rather than its count. Include all tied highest values.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 2
explanation.text: Data: 4, 4, 7, 7, 9. Both 4 and 7 appear twice, so the data are bimodal: 4 and 7.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 3
explanation.text: Data: 1, 3, 5, 7. Every value appears once. No mode is distinguished.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 4
explanation.text: A table lists prices $10, $20, $30 with frequencies 2, 6, 4. The mode is $20, not 6.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 5
explanation.text: Two groups report A: blue 3, red 5 and B: blue 4, red 1. Combined blue 7, red 6, so blue is modal.

explanation.heading: FREQUENCY TABLE STRATEGY
explanation.text: For a frequency table, compare the frequency column, then read the associated value from the value column. For groups, sum matching categories first.

explanation.heading: COMMON MISTAKES
explanation.text: Do not confuse mode with mean or median; do not select the largest number; do not report the frequency itself as the mode; do not omit tied modes.

explanation.heading: EXAM STRATEGY
explanation.text: A quick tally is usually faster and safer than graphing. Check for ties and for data added or removed before deciding.

explanation.heading: QUICK CHECK
explanation.text: For 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, the modes are 1 and 3. For 4, 5, 6, there is no mode.

explanation.heading: LESSON RECAP
explanation.text: Mode = most frequent observation. It may be one value, several tied values, or no mode. Tables and combined data use the same counting rule.

explanation.heading: NEXT STEP
explanation.text: Apply the frequency-counting rule to Practice Problems, inspect worked Answers & Solutions, then submit the five-question Lesson Test.

practice.question: Which value is the mode of 2, 4, 4, 7?
practice.solution: 4 appears twice; every other value appears once.

practice.question: Find every mode of 1, 1, 2, 2, 3.
practice.solution: Both 1 and 2 appear twice, more than 3.

practice.question: Does 3, 5, 7, 9 have a mode?
practice.solution: Every value occurs once; no value is more frequent.

practice.question: Find the mode of 8, 3, 8, 5, 3, 8, 5.
practice.solution: 8 appears three times, whereas 3 and 5 each appear twice.

practice.question: Identify the most frequent value in 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6, 6.
practice.solution: 6 occurs four times, more than 5 (three) and 4 (two).

practice.question: A frequency table shows scores 1, 2, 3 with frequencies 2, 5, 3. What is the mode?
practice.solution: The largest frequency is 5, attached to score 2; the frequency 5 is not the mode.

practice.question: A survey records red 4 times, blue 6 times, and green 5 times. Which category is modal?
practice.solution: Blue has the greatest category frequency, 6.

practice.question: Find the modes of 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6.
practice.solution: 4 and 6 each occur three times; both are modes.

practice.question: A tally gives 0:1, 1:3, 2:4, 3:2. What is the mode?
Find the mode of 4, 4, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6, 7, 7, 7, 7.
practice.solution: 7 occurs four times; 5 and 6 occur three times each.

practice.question: The data are 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3. Add one observation of 1. What are the new modes?
practice.solution: After adding 1, both 1 and 2 have frequency three.

practice.question: A frequency table lists 10:7, 20:5, 30:7. State all modes.
practice.solution: Values 10 and 30 share the largest frequency, 7.

practice.question: Class A scores are 4, 4, 5, 6, 6, 6; class B scores are 4, 4, 4, 5, 6, 6. Compare the modes.
practice.solution: In A, 6 appears three times; in B, 4 appears three times.

practice.question: Each value in 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3 is increased by 5. Find the new mode.
practice.solution: The original mode 3 occurs three times. Adding 5 to each value makes its mode 8.

practice.question: For 1, 1, 1, 8, 8, find the mode and mean. Are they equal?
practice.solution: 1 appears three times. The sum is 19 and 19/5=3.8.

practice.question: The value 10 is removed from 1, 2, 2, 3, 10. Does the mode change?
practice.solution: 2 is the only value with frequency two both before and after removing 10.

practice.question: For 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6, how many extra observations of 5 are needed to make 5 the unique mode?
practice.solution: Initially 5 has frequency two, while 4 and 6 each have three. Two more 5s raise its frequency to four.

practice.question: Group A records 2 five times and 3 twice. Group B records 2 once and 3 six times. What is the mode of the combined groups?
practice.solution: Combined frequency of 2 is 5+1=6; of 3 is 2+6=8, so 3 is modal.

test.question: Find the mode of 2, 3, 3, 4.
test.solution: 3 occurs twice; 2 and 4 each occur once.

test.question: Find all modes of 5, 5, 6, 6, 7.
test.solution: 5 and 6 each occur twice, the highest frequency.

test.question: A table shows values 1, 2, 3 with frequencies 2, 3, 5. What is the mode?
test.solution: Value 3 has frequency 5, the greatest; 5 is the frequency, not the modal value.

test.question: Every observation in 2, 2, 4, 4, 4, 5 is multiplied by 3. What is the mode?
test.solution: Original mode 4 appears three times. Multiplication by 3 changes it to 12.

test.question: Group A has value 1 four times and 2 twice; group B has value 1 once and 2 five times. What is the combined mode?
test.solution: Combined counts: 1 occurs 4+1=5 times and 2 occurs 2+5=7 times, so 2 is modal.

english.title: Objective
english.narration: Find the most frequent value, even when the data are unsorted.

english.title: Meaning
english.narration: Mode describes what is common, not what is numerically greatest.

english.title: First example
english.narration: In 2, 2, 4, 5 the mode is 2 because it occurs twice.

english.title: Tally
english.narration: Build a frequency tally to avoid counting errors.

english.title: Ties
english.narration: A data set can have two modes if two values share the top count.

english.title: No mode
english.narration: When every distinct value occurs equally often, no value stands out.

english.title: Tables
english.narration: Choose the data value with the largest frequency, not the frequency number.

english.title: Categories
english.narration: Mode also works for colors and survey choices.

english.title: Updates
english.narration: Recount when an observation is added or removed.

english.title: Combined groups
english.narration: Sum matching frequencies across groups before comparing.

english.title: Exam trap
english.narration: Mode and mean answer different questions. Mode does not need arithmetic averaging.

english.title: Recap
english.narration: Tally, compare, report every tied maximum, and verify the context.

arabic.title: الهدف
arabic.narration: نتعلم إيجاد القيمة الأكثر تكرارًا في مجموعة بيانات.

arabic.title: المعنى
arabic.narration: المنوال ليس أكبر قيمة عددية بل القيمة التي تظهر أكثر.

arabic.title: مثال أول
arabic.narration: في البيانات 2، 2، 4، 5 المنوال هو 2 لأنه تكرر مرتين.

arabic.title: العد
arabic.narration: أنشئ جدول تكرار لتجنب الخطأ أثناء العد.

arabic.title: التعادل
arabic.narration: قد يوجد منوالان إذا تساوت قيمتان في أكبر تكرار.

arabic.title: بلا منوال
arabic.narration: إذا تكررت جميع القيم المختلفة بالعدد نفسه فلا توجد قيمة مميزة.

arabic.title: الجداول
arabic.narration: اختر القيمة المقابلة لأكبر تكرار، وليس رقم التكرار نفسه.

arabic.title: الفئات
arabic.narration: يمكن استخدام المنوال مع الألوان والاختيارات.

arabic.title: التحديث
arabic.narration: أعد العد عند إضافة مشاهدة أو حذفها.

arabic.title: دمج المجموعات
arabic.narration: اجمع تكرارات القيمة نفسها بين المجموعات أولًا.

arabic.title: فخ الاختبار
arabic.narration: لا تخلط بين المنوال والمتوسط الحسابي.

arabic.title: الخلاصة
arabic.narration: احسب التكرارات وقارنها واذكر جميع القيم المتعادلة.
